data.name: Alila Mayakoba
data.address: CARRETERA FEDERAL, Carr. Tulum - Cancún Km. 298, Solidaridad, 77710 Playa del Carmen, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
Set within a lush resort complex with a lagoon, this upscale resort on a tranquil stretch of sandy beach is 10 km from Punta Esmeralda beach and 12 km from Fundadores Park.
Airy rooms decorated with local artwork feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and complimentary minibars, plus balconies or patios. Upgraded rooms offer beach or lagoon views. Suites add separate living areas and private plunge pools.
Dining options include an all-day buffet, a Latin American eatery and a beachfront seafood restaurant, plus a cocktail bar with snacks. There are also 2 outdoor pools, along with a hot tub, a gym and a spa. There's also a kids' club.
